title: WhenDo: AI Auto Clicker Macro
shortDescription: Task automation & scheduler: triggers, gestures, workflows — no root needed.
tagline: AI automation, auto clicker, and macro maker for Android — no coding

sections.title: AI automation, auto clicker, and macro maker for Android — no coding
paragraphs: Describe a routine in plain words and WhenDo's AI builds the automation for you: triggers, conditions, and actions, all editable. Prefer to build it yourself? Schedule tasks, record gestures, and run an auto clicker on any app. No root required.

sections.title: Build Automations with AI
paragraphs: “Mute my phone when I connect to home Wi-Fi”
“Open my music app when headphones connect”
“Turn on Do Not Disturb every night at 11”
“Remind me to drink water every two hours”
bullets: Describe a routine in your own words, or use voice input
AI creates the whole workflow — every trigger, condition, and action
Review and edit any step before you turn it on
Get started faster with ready-made examples and templates

sections.title: Auto Clicker, Gesture Recorder & Screen Automation
bullets: Auto clicker with adjustable click interval and repeat count
Record and replay taps, swipes, and multi-step gestures
Swipe by direction, distance, and speed, or by exact coordinates
Floating trigger buttons — start any task from a button on screen
Floating Assistant to pick screen elements and automate app UI
Take a screenshot, press Back, or turn the screen off

sections.title: Task Scheduler and 250+ Triggers
bullets: Time, schedules, Calendar events, location, and geofences
App launched or closed, recent apps, screen and UI events
Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, headset, and network changes
Notifications, calls, sensors, NFC, and clipboard
Physical keys such as volume up and down, and fingerprint gestures

sections.title: Macro Actions for Everything
bullets: Volume, brightness, Do Not Disturb, and other system settings
Launch apps, media controls, HTTP requests, files, and text
Intent shortcuts: dial, SMS, email, map search, directions, web search
Clipboard and notification actions, plus optional Shizuku controls

sections.title: Simple or Advanced Workflows
bullets: Combine When, If, Then, Else, delays, loops, and variables
Add multiple triggers and conditions to a single task
Run background Resident Tasks or manual One-Tap Tasks
Organize routines with customizable Scenes
Import, export, back up, and restore your automations

sections.title: Everyday Automation Ideas
paragraphs: Routines for work, home, sleep, and driving:
bullets: Silence your phone during meetings or at bedtime
Launch music when Bluetooth headphones connect
Open navigation when you start driving
Auto click repetitive buttons instead of tapping them yourself
Start apps automatically by time, location, or device event

sections.title: Privacy, Permissions, and No Root
bullets: Your automation tasks run directly on your device
AI generation needs internet and sends your prompt to the AI service
Accessibility is used only for the features your tasks require
No root for everyday tasks; optional Shizuku adds advanced control
Review or revoke permissions in Android settings at any time

sections.title: Made for Beginners and Power Users
paragraphs: New to phone automation? Start with AI, examples, and ready-made templates.
Need more control? Build conditional workflows, automate UI interactions, use variables, record gestures, or turn on Shizuku mode.

sections.title: Describe your routine, let WhenDo build it, and automate your Android phone.
